description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI' responsible for validating the uniqueness of project activity names within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It handles HTTP GET requests to check if a given activity name is already taken for a specified project and activity ID, utilizing various DAO and service methods. The class includes validation rules for request parameters and adheres to the API structure defined by the OrangeHRM framework.

classes.name: ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of project activity names, handling GET requests to check if an activity name is available or already used within a specific project context.

methods.description: Handles the GET request to verify if a project activity name is valid (not taken) for a specific project and optionally a specific activity ID.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for parameters required in the getOne method, such as project ID, activity name, and optional activity ID.
